sloka: न एव देवा महत्मनो न अत्र कार्या विचारणा ।शरा रामेण तु उत्सृष्टा रुक्मपुंखाः पतत्रिणः ॥३-३१-१८॥
transliteration: na eva devā mahatmano na atra kāryā vicāraṇā ।śarā rāmeṇa tu utsṛṣṭā rukmapuṁkhāḥ patatriṇaḥ ॥3-31-18॥

translations.english: Indeed, they are great men. No god came there (to lend him a hand). There is no need to investigate further about it. The goldenfeathered arrows released by Rama turned into fivehooded serpents and consumed the demons.
translations.hindi: ओर घोर गर्जना कर, दोनों सुजाओं से उस वृक्ष को, श्रीराम जी को लक्ष्य कर और यह कह; कर कि, “बस, अब तू मारा गया? फेंका
